caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright, hexagonal glass bottle rendered in various shades of blue. The bottle has a narrow neck with a thicker lip and two decorative rings below the mouth. Its body is decorated with raised, arched window-like patterns and floral medallion motifs on each face. At the base of each side, there are embossed capital letters, with “CA,” “PT,” and “LE” visible on three sides. The bottle is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there are no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "Jack Williamson," is written in small letters near the bottom right of the bottle.
title: Ink Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
